evals.prompt: Our Astro site on Cloudflare Workers has been live for two months and still doesn't show up in Google at all. Can you figure out why?
assertions: Checks crawler access on the live site (robots.txt as served, noindex headers or meta, crawler user agents blocked at the edge) before content advice
Names Cloudflare's AI bot policy Training = Block (or Block on pages with ads, or legacy Block AI bots) as a setting that also blocks Googlebot since 2026-09-15
Checks that canonicals and the sitemap carry the production URL and the trailing-slash form the site serves with 200
Recommends verifying in Search Console (Page indexing, URL Inspection) rather than guessing

evals.prompt: How do we get our meetup site cited when people ask ChatGPT or Perplexity about tech events in our region? Should we add an llms.txt?
assertions: Distinguishes search and user-fetch crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot) from training crawlers and says the former must be allowed
States that there is no evidence llms.txt changes visibility and that Google ignores it
Does not present the GEO paper's up-to-40 % figure as an expected gain
Recommends being indexed in Google and Bing, content in the initial HTML, answer-first pages with concrete facts, and measuring with repeated runs

evals.prompt: I want to stop AI companies training on our website but stay visible in Google and in AI search answers. What should I set in Cloudflare and robots.txt?
assertions: Recommends Cloudflare's Disallow AI Training setting and warns against Training = Block
Lists training tokens (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot) separately from search crawlers in robots.txt
Says Google-Extended does not control AI Overviews and is a robots.txt token only

evals.prompt: When I share our homepage on LinkedIn or WhatsApp there's no image in the preview. Can you fix it?
assertions: Checks that og:image is an absolute URL to a file that actually exists and answers 200
Recommends a 1200x630 image under 600 KB with og:image:width, og:image:height and og:image:alt
Explains refreshing the preview by changing the image URL and re-scraping with LinkedIn Post Inspector

evals.prompt: We launch the new Hugo site next week, deployed with wrangler. Do an SEO check on it first.
assertions: Runs or proposes the build scan (seo_scan.py site) and the live scan with the mirror hostnames
Checks not_found_handling returns real 404s and that workers.dev, preview and staging hosts are not indexable
Covers sitemap with real lastmod, robots.txt Sitemap line, Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools via DNS, and IndexNow from production deploys only

evals.prompt: Google keeps showing our Dutch page to English searchers and the other way round. The site has /nl and /en versions.
assertions: Prescribes reciprocal hreflang on every version including itself, plus x-default
Advises against redirecting by Accept-Language or IP address
Keeps each language version as its own canonical
